segments.name: Hot Sauce Shot
segments.description: One teammate eats 1 spoonful of hot sauce ➔ 1 free unpenalized hint docket awarded from Tech Leads.

segments.name: Public Intel Drop
segments.description: Host broadcasts an overarching 1-sentence clue on the projector screen for all teams.

segments.name: 5-Min Speed Window
segments.description: If the spinning team solves any challenge within the next 5 minutes, they earn +50 bonus points.

segments.name: 2-Min Keyboard Freeze
segments.description: The entire spinning team must step back from computers for 120 seconds.

segments.name: Eliminate a Decoy
segments.description: Host publicly eliminates one innocent suspect profile from the case dossier board.

segments.name: Teammate Role Swap
segments.description: Teammates swap seats and workstations for the next 10 minutes.

segments.name: Sweet Relief
segments.description: A bowl of chocolates / candy delivered directly to the team's workstation.

segments.name: Sound the Alarm
segments.description: Lab PA system sounds the intrusion alarm siren for 5 seconds.
